description: Interleaved desktop comparison of eager and viewport-driven template previews

environment.samples: six matched pairs; new browser profile per variant and pair; service-worker-controlled warm reload

baseline.description: Production release build immediately before on-demand previews

candidate.description: Production release build with on-demand previews

method.loader_ms: Browser-observed loading-overlay removal from navigation time origin.
method.interaction_ms: Ctrl+O invokes an injected file-picker shim that cancels immediately; includes automation overhead.
method.cold: Fresh browser profile and context, with empty browser storage and cache.
method.warm: Subsequent navigation controlled by the installed service worker.
method.ordering: baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline, candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate, baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline

limitations: These few noisy desktop samples do not demonstrate a startup improvement or an overhead bound.
The OS file cache was not cleared; the loopback server and uncompressed responses do not represent production delivery.
The shim does not exercise a real file picker; no physical iPad, touch, GPU presentation, or screen-reader acceptance was measured.
The experiment does not measure first-scroll latency, memory, or the reported two-minute iPad startup.
